name: tstat
expr: [m_s, v_s] = tstat(5); [m_v, v_v] = tstat([3 5 10]); [m_2, v_2] = tstat(2); m_1 = tstat(1); m_0 = tstat(0); m_neg = tstat(-1);
comment: Sig: [m, v] = tstat(nu). Student's t: m=0 if nu>1, v=nu/(nu-2) if nu>2. Vectorised. nu<=0 => NaN/NaN; 0<nu<=1 => m=NaN,v=NaN; 1<nu<=2 => m=0, v=NaN.
